subject: AWS partner intro + account mapping request: Acero Health
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Kirsten Brooks <kirsten.brooks@amazon.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS partner intro + account mapping request: Acero Health

Kirsten —

Hope you’re well. I’m reaching out to kick off an AWS introduction for a promising mid-market healthcare opportunity: Acero Health. We’re mid-POC and the customer has asked us to engage AWS for co-sell support and to evaluate an AWS Marketplace listing for a hosted deployment offering.

Quick context:
- Acero Health (Healthcare SaaS, ~250 employees) is running a 6-week POC with Redwood Dedicated for inference on patient summarization workloads.
- Technical champion: Diego Ramos (CTO) — diego.ramos@acerohealth.com
- Commercial lead: Maria Cortez (VP Product) — mentioned they want an AWS-backed procurement path to accelerate procurement and pricing.
- Target timeline: decision by end of Q4 2026, pilot expansion in Q1 2027.

What we need from AWS:
1) Intro to Partner Sales / AM so we can align co-sell registration and any incentives.
2) Joint Account Plan (JAP) sync to map motions (who owns outreach to procurement, timelines, target SKUs).
3) Quick checklist on marketplace listing requirements and any redlines we should expect on pricing/usage metrics.

Suggested next step: a 30-min sync this week to map stakeholders and confirm who will submit the co-sell registration. Marcus (cc’d) will own the commercial details and Olga will handle technical onboarding.

I’ve attached a draft JAP and our security FAQ for their pre-read.

Attachments: JAP-Acero-2026-v1.xlsx, redwood-security-faq.pdf

Thanks — appreciate any help you can provide.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Kirsten Brooks <kirsten.brooks@amazon.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Sullivan <mike.sullivan@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS partner intro + account mapping request: Acero Health

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the detailed note and the materials — very helpful. Happy to coordinate. I can take the intro on the Partner Sales side and will loop in Mike (AM) to make sure the account team is aligned.

A few quick asks so we can be productive in the JAP sync:
- Can you share Acero’s AWS Account ID (or their primary billing/ops contact) so we can validate partnership benefits?
- Please confirm the AM/SA we should align with on the AWS side (I’ve cc’d Mike; he can nominate a Solutions Architect once we confirm timing).
- If you have a draft marketplace listing (SKU/pricing/usage model) please send it; otherwise we’ll run through the checklist in our meeting.

I have availability for a 30-min call tomorrow (Tue) 10:00–11:30am PT or Wed 2:00–4:00pm PT. Do either work for you, Marcus, and Diego?

Attaching: aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf — includes common gating items and typical timelines.

-Kirsten
Kirsten Brooks
Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace & GTM
kirsten.brooks@amazon.com | +1 (206) 555-0841

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kirsten Brooks <kirsten.brooks@amazon.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@acerohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS partner intro + account mapping request: Acero Health

Thanks Kirsten — tomorrow at 10:30am PT works for me (I can do 10:00–11:30 window). Naomi — Diego is ok with the time.

Per your request, some quick account details below:
- Acero AWS Account ID: 842711009234
- Primary billing contact: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@acerohealth.com>
- Our proposed marketplace SKU: redwood-inference-acero-hosted — subscription hourly with committed monthly minimum (we’ll share pricing matrix in the JAP).
- Target go-live (if awarded co-sell): Jan 2027 pilot scale; broader rollout Q2 2027.

Pre-reads: Naomi uploaded the JAP draft to the shared drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cJAP-Acero — please review before the call.

Olga — can you prepare a 5-min tech slide on integration touch points (VPC peering, IAM roles, logging) so we can cover dependencies?

On the marketplace listing: we’re likely to request an ISV co-sell SKU with usage-based billing. We’ll need AWS approval for the pricing tier and any promotional credits.

See you tomorrow at 10:30am PT.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

All — thanks for the quick responses. I’ve scheduled a 30-min JAP sync for Tue 03 Aug 2026 10:30–11:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

Pre-reads / asks before the call:
- Marcus: please confirm the SKU/pricing matrix you plan to propose (if possible, upload to the Drive link Naomi shared).
- Naomi/Olga: brief security summary — a short list of compliance controls (SOC2 + data residency notes) will help speed the marketplace review.
- Diego: if procurement prefers a marketplace procurement path, please confirm the internal approver and any contract thresholds that require legal review.

I’ve started the co-sell registration so we have an entry in the Partner Network — Mike will follow up on SA assignment. I’ve also attached the AWS marketplace checklist that calls out typical lead times and required artifacts.

Related: I’ll open a support ticket with Marketplace Ops to surface any potential gating items for healthcare verticals (privacy/data controls). If you have specific questions, add them to the drive doc and I’ll include them in the ticket.

Attachments: aws-marketplace-checklist.pdf

Looking forward — see you on the call.

-Kirsten
